updates.title: What's new
updates.unread: What's new — version {{version}} is ready to read

v204.body: Snake's ModPack Build 42 is now available as one library entry. Turning it on or off applies all seven included map mods together. Truncated mod names now reveal their full name on hover.

v203.body:
Live Tracker improved! Your position and facing direction now update automatically in multiplayer, too.

Fort Benning B42 and Nellis Air Force Base are now available with detailed maps, loot locations and spawn points. Remote interiors are now included in map coverage.

v202.body: West Point Expansion B42 has been added to the mod library, with isometric map tiles, searchable locations and navigation data.

v200.body:
Explore buildings floor by floor. Use the new control on the right side of the map to move through basements, Ground and upper levels up to 9 without losing your place.

Markers now understand building levels. Basements stay isolated, upper levels keep useful context from below, your personal markers remember where they were placed, and your live position only appears on a matching level.

Markers are smaller and clearer, grow gently as you zoom in, and can be resized from 75% to 150% in Settings. Town labels avoid nearby pins more reliably, and the map background now blends cleanly into the surrounding canvas.

v109.body: SecretZ Pandemic (Alpha) is here with 15 areas, search, loot and navigation. Labels now sit near recognizable buildings.

v108.body:
Vila Z and Fort Preston have been added to the mod library, with isometric map tiles, searchable locations and navigation data.

An updates page has been added. Open it from the bell icon to read what's new in each version. The dot marks an update you haven't read yet.

v220.body: New in the mod library: Greenport, KY (B42), Maplewood.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick fixes for common problems
faq.intro: Start with these checks when the map or game integration does not behave as expected.

livePosition.question: Why can't the map track my position?
livePosition.answer: Open Mods in Project Zomboid and enable Project Zomboid Map Bridge. If the mod is not listed, reinstall it from Settings, then restart the game.

minimapCursor.question: Why can't I move or interact with the minimap?
minimapCursor.answer: Project Zomboid may be locking the mouse cursor to the game. Open Options in-game, go to User Interface (UI), find Lock the Cursor, and clear its checkbox. You should then be able to drag and use the minimap normally.

overlay.question: Why doesn't the in-game map or minimap open?
overlay.answer: Review the app hotkeys and make sure the Overwolf overlay is enabled for Project Zomboid. The default full-map hotkey is Ctrl + M.

mapMods.question: Why doesn't the map match my modded world?
mapMods.answer: Enable the same supported map mods you use in Project Zomboid and keep their priority aligned with your in-game Map Order.

firstLaunch.question: Why is live position unavailable after installing the app?
firstLaunch.answer: Project Zomboid creates its user folder after the game runs for the first time. Launch the game once, close it completely, then reopen it so the Bridge mod can finish installing.
